descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S27 Every note template offered on main finishes into one timeline line

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Hospital patient and resident with today's pre-round line; model calls mocked (mockNoteFinish)

When Generate once per template offered in the picker (src/lib/templates.ts): Hospital H&P, SOAP progress, Consult, Discharge; Nursing Home SNF admission, SNF follow-up

Then Each gives exactly one finished line for today carrying the mocked entry, with no pending marker and no 'Encounter done'

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on the stored ledger per template: one line for today, equal to '<today>: <entry>' (Hospital) or 'Visit 1 · <today>: <entry>' (Nursing Home). AC 2 says every completed note. The Hospital Addendum path (useNoteGeneration.ts `template.id === "addendum"`) saves the note and returns before the course is touched, so it would leave today's '⏳ Encounter pending' …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S27

Every note template offered on main finishes into one timeline line

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status passed in newspec-b/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec in course-timeline.spec.ts style: one fresh chart per template offered in the picker (Hospital H&P, SOAP progress, Consult, Discharge; NH SNF admission, SNF follow-up); pick the template, Generate Note & Finish with generateNote and every follow-up answered at the socket (mockNoteFinish; no request reaches the backend); assert the stored ledger has exactly one finished line for today. — Generate is pressed but generateNote is answered at the socket, so no model and no server generateNote run; same pattern Tim's course-timeline.spec.ts already runs in lane A.

Detail:

All six templates offered on main (H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note, Discharge summary; SNF admission, SNF follow-up), each on a fresh chart: exactly one line for today, '<Oct 14>: Dyspnea and pulmonary exam improved' / 'Visit 1 · Oct 14: Participating in therapy, appetite improved', no '⏳', no 'Encounter done'; noteTemplate stored as picked. generateNote and every follow-up answered at the socket, any other ai/* refused: no AI call reached the backend.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): one fresh chart per template with mockNoteFinish, seeded through the local admin helpers on a fresh @roundai.test account; dev has no admin key, one shared account and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
